signals.text: Running `wordcount -` reads UTF-8 text from standard input instead of a file path.
signals.possible_indication: Lets wordcount sit at the end of a shell pipeline, which a PATH-only command cannot do.

signals.text: Standard input was deferred as a non-goal in STRAT-0001, STRAT-0002 and STRAT-0003, and this work item takes it up.
signals.possible_indication: A known, long-standing gap, not a new request.

signals.text: Input read from stdin prints the same `words: <N> characters: <M> lines: <L>` line, using the existing word, character and line rules.

signals.possible_indication: Mirrors the empty-file case from SPEC-0003.

signals.text: Invalid UTF-8 on stdin is a file-style error with exit status 1 that names `<stdin>`.
signals.possible_indication: The single-line, no-traceback error contract for files should also hold for stdin.

signals.text: Running `wordcount` with no argument stays a usage error with exit status 2.
signals.possible_indication: Stdin is opt-in through '-', so the existing usage contract must not change.

signals.text: The README and acceptance tests must be updated to cover stdin input.

DISCOVER.core_issue: Users can count only a named file. They cannot count text piped into wordcount through standard input.
DISCOVER.impact_value: Stdin input lets wordcount join shell pipelines without temporary files. It closes a gap deferred across three strategy documents.
DISCOVER.discovery_method: Written feature request in the handoff, checked against STRAT-0001..0003 non-goals and SPEC-0001..0003.
DISCOVER.pattern_dependencies: Stdin counting is the root pattern. The invalid UTF-8 error on stdin only exists once stdin can be read. Keeping the no-argument usage error is a constraint on how stdin counting is invoked. The README and test updates follow from stdin counting.

pattern_narratives.current_state: wordcount accepts only one PATH argument and reads only from that file.

pattern_narratives.applies_to: wordcount error output for stdin input
pattern_narratives.frequency: Whenever non-UTF-8 bytes are piped in
pattern_narratives.current_state: Invalid UTF-8 handling exists only for files, with a message naming the file PATH.
No argument prints argparse usage to stderr and exits with status 2.
